hooks.command: STAGED=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null); UNPUSHED=$(git log --oneline origin/main..HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$STAGED" ] || [ -n "$UNPUSHED" ]; then MSG="END-OF-SESSION: There are local changes not yet on GitHub."; [ -n "$STAGED" ] && MSG="$MSG Uncommitted: $(echo "$STAGED" | wc -l | tr -d ' ') file(s)."; [ -n "$UNPUSHED" ] && MSG="$MSG Unpushed commits: $(echo "$UNPUSHED" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')."; echo "{\"continue\": true, \"hookSpecificOutput\": {\"hookEventName\": \"Stop\", \"additionalContext\": \"$MSG Ask the user: 'There are changes not yet pushed to GitHub — would you like me to commit and push them now?' If they approve, stage all changes, commit with a clear summary, and push to origin main.\"}}"; fi
